content: For the most part, I am satisfied with the app's ability to place an order for my favourite coffees. I often add Starbucks eCard numbers to my app, almost all of them in US funds (I am in Canada), Unfortunately, the app does not allow for balance transfers from international cards to any other card numbers, be it US or Canadian numbers. I typically have 15 to 20 different balances on cards in my app. And as the app does not allow you to pay with more than one card, I end up with 18 of the 20 cards having balances under a dollar. The only way to use these is go inside (Hi Kevin @ Chemong!) and pay for my order with a pile of $0.05, cards, $0,23 cards, $0.27 cards, ad nauseum. Again, probably does not impact most users, but it is an inconvenience to the great employees (who are never bothered), the customers behind me (who are either bothered or amused), and myself (who would prefer to not inconvenience others). So please, Starbucks dev team - allow for the international balance transfers, or allow us to pay with more than one eCard number in the app! Or both! This is a deal breaker for me.
